title: UMbusi Owadabula Imikhawulo Yomhlaba
intro: Cabanga ngombusi onamandla, onikwe amandla negunya phezu kwezwe. Lo muntu waqala uhambo olungavamile, efika endaweni lapho ilanga lishona khona nendawo lapho liphuma khona, ehlangana nabantu abangaziwa futhi ebhekene nenselele enkulu evela ezizweni ezimbili ezonakele. Ungubani lo mholi oyimfihlakalo?
clues: Ngangingumbusi onikwe igunya nezindlela zokufinyelela emagumbini akude omhlaba.
Ngaya entshonalanga ngabona ilanga lishona entwasahlobo emnyama.
Ngihlangane nabantu eduze kwelanga eliphumayo ababengenandawo yokucashela ekushiseni kwalo.
Omunye umphakathi ucele usizo lwami ngokumelene nezizwe ezimbili ezonakalisayo ezaziwa ngokuthi uGogi noMagogi.
Ngakha isithiyo ngisebenzisa insimbi nethusi elincibilikisiwe ukuze ngizigcine.
Ngamemezela ukuthi lesi sivikelo sasiyisihawu esivela eNkosini yami, futhi sizohlala kuze kube yisikhathi esimisiwe.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: UGogi noMagogi bavinjelwa kwaze kwaba yisikhathi esimisiwe
outcome.answer: UGogi noMagogi bavinjelwa kwaze kwaba yisikhathi esimisiwe

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
